---
name: Bug report
about: Report a problem with fictional or redacted examples
---

Describe what you expected and what happened. Include the app version, OS,
terminal and steps to reproduce with `--demo` if possible.

Do not attach real email, credentials, `.env`, cache files or environment dumps.
Inspect/redact any diagnostics before sharing. Use the private security channel
described in SECURITY.md for sensitive vulnerabilities.
